# Motion Lab

> Zero-dependency interactive UI motion playground and component catalog (12 live motion studies + 8 interactive UI widgets + 6 easing curves), ready to consume by humans and AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Antigravity) via `llms.txt`, `registry.json`, Agent Skill, or MCP server.

## Machine-Readable Endpoints
- [Complete Registry JSON](https://hmkkaii.github.io/motion-lab/registry.json): Structured JSON containing all 6 easing curves, 7 duration tokens, 12 motion studies (with CSS/JS), and 8 interactive UI components (with full HTML/CSS/JS).
- [Full Single-File Reference](https://hmkkaii.github.io/motion-lab/llms-full.txt): Complete Markdown dump of every token, motion study, and interactive component in one fetch.
- [Agent Skill (SKILL.md)](https://github.com/hmkkaii/motion-lab/blob/main/skills/motion-lab/SKILL.md): Installable skill instructions for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Antigravity.
- [MCP Server & Setup Guide](https://hmkkaii.github.io/motion-lab/ai.html): Copy-paste MCP setup for Python (`mcp/motion-lab-mcp.py`) and Node.js (`mcp/motion-lab-mcp.mjs`).

## Live Interactive Pages
- [Motion Studies Gallery (12 Studies)](https://hmkkaii.github.io/motion-lab/index.html): Live clickable previews across Surfaces, Navigation, Feedback, and Micro-Motion.
- [Interactive UI Components (8 Widgets)](https://hmkkaii.github.io/motion-lab/components.html): Hands-on interactive controls, aviation pass, spatial audio deck, mesh studio, timer, edge deploy, 3D shelf, and issue triage card.
- [Parameter Workbench](https://hmkkaii.github.io/motion-lab/study.html?id=adaptive-card): Live CSS variable tuning, slow-motion (1x / 0.5x / 0.25x), and reduced-motion simulator.
- [Easing Curve Lab](https://hmkkaii.github.io/motion-lab/tokens.html): Synchronized 6-curve race track.

## 12 Motion Studies
- [Adaptive Card Resize](https://hmkkaii.github.io/motion-lab/study.html?id=adaptive-card) (`adaptive-card` · Surfaces · 300ms · smooth-out): Smooth width and height continuity when a surface toggles density.
- [Origin-Aware Action Menu](https://hmkkaii.github.io/motion-lab/study.html?id=origin-menu) (`origin-menu` · Surfaces · 250ms in / 150ms out): Anchored popover growing from its trigger with asymmetric open and close timings.
- [Focal Scale Dialog](https://hmkkaii.github.io/motion-lab/study.html?id=scale-dialog) (`scale-dialog` · Surfaces · 250ms in / 150ms out): Centered confirmation dialog pairing subtle 0.96 scale with a soft backdrop veil.
- [Measured Sliding Tabs](https://hmkkaii.github.io/motion-lab/study.html?id=sliding-tabs) (`sliding-tabs` · Navigation · 250ms · measured pill): Segmented control whose active pill measures width and offset for fluid tracking.
- [Grid-Row Accordion](https://hmkkaii.github.io/motion-lab/study.html?id=accordion-disclosure) (`accordion-disclosure` · Navigation · 250ms · 0fr ↔ 1fr): Intrinsic height disclosure driven by CSS grid-template-rows with synced chevron flip.
- [Directional View Slide](https://hmkkaii.github.io/motion-lab/study.html?id=page-transition) (`page-transition` · Navigation · 250ms · ±10px + 3px blur): Forward and backward drill-down view swap with directional offset and cross-blur.
- [Stacked Notification Banners](https://hmkkaii.github.io/motion-lab/study.html?id=toast-stack) (`toast-stack` · Feedback · 350ms in · Hover/Tap fan-out): Three-deep notification deck that rises in, recedes with depth blur, and fans on hover or tap.
- [Segmented Validation Shake](https://hmkkaii.github.io/motion-lab/study.html?id=validation-shake) (`validation-shake` · Feedback · 280ms shake · 3s auto-revert): Tactile horizontal rejection shake on invalid input with automatic neutral recovery.
- [Composed Success Check](https://hmkkaii.github.io/motion-lab/study.html?id=confirm-check) (`confirm-check` · Feedback · 500ms · 80ms stroke delay): Multi-track celebration combining fade, rotate, vertical bounce, de-blur, and SVG stroke draw.
- [Spring Heart & Particle Burst](https://hmkkaii.github.io/motion-lab/study.html?id=spring-like) (`spring-like` · Micro-Motion · 350ms pop · 600ms burst): Overshoot spring pop paired with a nine-particle radial burst on positive toggle.
- [3D Drum Counter](https://hmkkaii.github.io/motion-lab/study.html?id=drum-counter) (`drum-counter` · Micro-Motion · 520ms · 40ms stagger): Selective digit-roll counter where only changed digits animate with blur and stagger.
- [Magnetic Avatar Wave & 3D Tilt](https://hmkkaii.github.io/motion-lab/study.html?id=hover-cluster) (`hover-cluster` · Micro-Motion · 320ms wave · 3D glare): Distance-falloff hover lift with bouncy return paired with pointer-tracked 3D card tilt.

## 8 Interactive UI Components
- [Pulse Climate Dial](https://hmkkaii.github.io/motion-lab/components.html#pulse-climate) (`pulse-climate` · Controls): Circular architectural thermostat with 36 precision ticks, glowing conic arc, stepper controls, and ambient mood switcher.
- [Orbit Live Flight Pass](https://hmkkaii.github.io/motion-lab/components.html#orbit-flight) (`orbit-flight` · Cards): Cobalt aviation tracker with SVG great-circle flight path, pulsing radar plane indicator, and live boarding tab transition.
- [Tempo Spatial Audio Deck](https://hmkkaii.github.io/motion-lab/components.html#tempo-audio) (`tempo-audio` · Media): Obsidian hi-fi vinyl player with 18-bar animated harmonic equalizer and color-shifting Studio / Warm / Spatial sound presets.
- [Chroma Palette Studio](https://hmkkaii.github.io/motion-lab/components.html#chroma-mesh) (`chroma-mesh` · Creative): Multi-layer radial mesh gradient studio with crossfading Solstice / Cobalt / Matcha themes, live OKLCH readout, and one-click CSS copy.
- [Focus Deep Work Timer](https://hmkkaii.github.io/motion-lab/components.html#focus-timer) (`focus-timer` · Productivity): Warm-paper Pomodoro timer with smooth SVG countdown ring, tabular digits, and Rain / Vinyl / Forest ambient chips.
- [Forge Edge Deploy Pipeline](https://hmkkaii.github.io/motion-lab/components.html#forge-deploy) (`forge-deploy` · Developer): Interactive deployment card that cascades through 4 staggered build stages with spring checkmarks and live edge latency status.
- [Design Shelf 3D Deck](https://hmkkaii.github.io/motion-lab/components.html#shelf-books) (`shelf-books` · Media): Tactile Swiss graphic book cover-flow with perspective depth stacking, synced reading progress bar, and spring bookmark toggle.
- [Relay Issue Triage Card](https://hmkkaii.github.io/motion-lab/components.html#relay-triage) (`relay-triage` · Productivity): Linear-inspired engineering issue card with interactive priority escalation, Ship PR state morph, QA bar fill, and reaction toggles.

## Core Motion Tokens
```css
:root {
  --ml-speed: 1;
  --duration-stagger: 40ms;
  --duration-micro: 80ms;
  --duration-quick: 150ms;
  --duration-fast: 250ms;
  --duration-medium: 350ms;
  --duration-slow: 400ms;
  --duration-very-slow: 500ms;

  --ease-smooth-out: cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
  --ease-bounce: cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.36, 0.64, 1);
  --ease-pop: cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.96, 0.64, 1);
  --ease-bounce-strong: cubic-bezier(0.34, 3.85, 0.64, 1);
  --ease-in-out: cubic-bezier(0.42, 0, 0.58, 1);
  --ease-out: cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.2, 1);
}
```

## MCP Tools (`mcp/motion-lab-mcp.py` / `mcp/motion-lab-mcp.mjs`)
- `list_motions(category?)`: List all 12 motion studies with specs and workbench URLs.
- `get_motion_spec(id)`: Return exact tokens, rationale, CSS, and JS implementation for one study.
- `list_components(category?)`: List all 8 interactive UI components with triggers and tokens.
- `get_component_code(id)`: Return complete self-contained HTML/CSS/JS implementation for one component.
- `get_easing_tokens()`: Return all 6 cubic-bezier curves, 7 durations, and `:root` CSS block.
